checks.name: persistent single-node private control plane template
args:
import json,sys,ipaddress
c=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
assert c["server"]["enabled"] and c["server"]["bootstrap_expect"]==1 and c["client"]["enabled"]
assert c["data_dir"].startswith("/") and c["acl"]["enabled"] is True
assert ipaddress.ip_address(c["bind_addr"]).is_loopback
for kind,port in [("http",4646),("rpc",4647),("serf",4648)]:
 assert ipaddress.ip_address(c["addresses"][kind]).is_loopback
 assert c["advertise"][kind]=="127.0.0.1:"+str(port)
assert c["client"]["servers"]==["127.0.0.1:4647"]
p={k:v for block in c["plugin"] for k,v in block.items()}
assert p["docker"]["config"]["endpoint"].startswith("unix://")
assert p["docker"]["config"]["allow_privileged"] is False
assert p["docker"]["config"]["volumes"]["enabled"] is False
assert p["raw_exec"]["config"]["enabled"] is False
print("PASS: persistent singleton, ACLs, loopback control plane, local Docker")
checks.expectedStdout: PASS: persistent singleton, ACLs, loopback control plane, local Docker

checks.name: persistent client service lifecycle template
args:
import configparser,sys
c=configparser.ConfigParser(strict=False); c.read(sys.argv[1])
s=c["Service"]; u=c["Unit"]
assert s["User"]=="root" and s["KillMode"]=="process" and s["KillSignal"]=="SIGINT"
assert s["Restart"]=="on-failure" and s["ExecStart"].endswith("agent -config=/etc/nomad.d")
assert "-dev" not in s["ExecStart"] and "docker.service" in u["After"] and "docker.service" in u["Requires"]
assert c["Install"]["WantedBy"]=="multi-user.target"
print("PASS: persistent Docker client service without dev mode")
checks.expectedStdout: PASS: persistent Docker client service without dev mode
